sources.fact: LBBD78/BB Tesco Car Park is 3.05ha, deliverable yes, minimum 1500 and maximum 1758 net dwellings; register status permissioned with note that the site is partly permissioned.
The Brownfield record separately notes new application 22/00262/FULL as pending decision in the register snapshot; this note is not treated as a current final decision.
The record supplies POINT (0.07139 51.535716) and blank geometry; the point is not the site red-line or title polygon.
Planning Committee considered exact application 18/02131/FUL for the southern part of Tesco Car Park.
18/02131/FUL proposed 514 residential units in five buildings of 9 to 23 storeys plus 90 sqm flexible retail/commercial floorspace.
Committee resolved to grant subject to Mayor direction, S106 and conditions; this resolution applies to the southern-part application only.
The committee record required 35% affordable housing on a habitable-room basis for that application.
LBBD Regulation 19 records include BB Tesco Car Park as a distinct site-allocation document, confirming allocation provenance rather than consent for the whole site.
LBBD Local Plan 2037 was adopted 18 September 2024 and is the starting point for current decision-making.
LBBD states all Brownfield Register sites require planning permission.
The adopted LBBD Local Plan and London Plan form part of the Development Plan; allocation is not itself a planning consent.
Current borough planning guidance keeps development-plan, developer-contribution and site-specific application controls distinct.

examples.result: 514 permitted units are confined to the southern-part application and are not expanded to the whole 3.05ha BB site.
1500-1758 is Brownfield/allocation capacity, not a consented-unit range.
The Brownfield register's pending-decision note is retained as snapshot evidence and not silently upgraded to a final outcome.
The BB point is not converted into a red-line or HMLR polygon.
Planning Committee resolution conditions/S106 are not assumed discharged.
35% affordable requirement is attached to the exact southern-part case, not the entire allocation.
Allocation provenance is not planning permission.
Promotion remains zero until exact current whole-site application status, HMLR title relation and statutory overlays are verified.
